limitations: Small stratified continuation smoke test of historical holdout states, not fresh independent game validation.
One state per recipe in each stratum, selected by sample-ID hash before seeing outcomes; strata are equally weighted.
Both policies receive the observed simulated state after every action and share per-step random uniforms for each seed.
Native search recomputes each step with a nominal 1000 ms budget (soft wall deadline), 60000 nodes; no cached macros.
This is this repository native online search, NOT upstream Raphael and NOT a 128-core teacher benchmark.
Model decision includes encoding, mask, ONNX and argmax; native decision includes search. IPC, loading and simulator excluded from decision timing.
Sampled success is not an all-outcomes proof. No model-to-search fallback is enabled in this comparison.
Skill-count comparison uses only paired trajectories where BOTH methods meet the original goal.
Predicted value is not used as a calibrated success probability.
